quality_gates.file_present: The declared output path exists in git after `git pull`. Checked at BOTH the un-doubled and the doubled path (audos-workspace-776786/audos-workspace-776786/data/...). A card is not complete when the agent reports writing the file; it is complete when the file is found in git and opened.
quality_gates.non_empty: Record count >= min_records and <= max_records. A file that exists but holds 0 data rows is a failure unless may_be_header_only is true.
quality_gates.schema: Every record validates against its declared JSON Schema $def. CSV is validated row-by-row as an object keyed by the header.
quality_gates.enum_discipline: Closed-vocabulary fields hold a legal value. Specifically catches verification_method='registry_lookup', which is not a legal value and violates a database CHECK constraint on our side.
quality_gates.sourcing_rule: source_url host is not on the denylist (google.*/maps, yelp, trustpilot, linkedin, pagesjaunes, societe.com, verif.com, facebook, instagram, wikipedia, medium, and 'top-10' aggregator paths). A row failing the sourcing rule is worse than a missing row, because someone will check it in a security review.
quality_gates.source_not_own_site: source_url host must differ from website_url host. A supplier's own marketing site can never be its accreditation evidence.
quality_gates.no_org_number_as_accreditation: accreditation_number / membership_number must not be a bare 9-digit Norwegian organisation number or a 9-digit French SIREN when the accreditation_body is a professional or bar association. This is the exact defect AIQ-1828 exists to fix; the gate stops it re-entering.
quality_gates.evidence_url_not_search_form: evidence_url must not be a bare search/landing page (path contains 'search', 'find-a-', 'sok', 'recherche' with no entity identifier). One of the four AIQ-1828 rows fails on precisely this.
quality_gates.label_discipline: Every claim-bearing object carries label ∈ {VERIFIED, CLAIM}. Otto cannot see our repo, database or CDN; unlabelled claims about them have been wrong before.
quality_gates.checked_date_present: Every sourced fact carries the date it was read. Legal and government pages change.
quality_gates.official_source_domains: For corridor and lead-time cards, source_url must be a government/statutory domain (.gov, .gov.uk, .gouv.fr, gov.ie, europa.eu, udi.no, skatteetaten.no, revenue.ie, enterprise.gov.ie, irishimmigration.ie, uscis.gov, travel.state.gov, and similar). Non-official sources are reported, not accepted silently.
quality_gates.number_requires_source: A non-empty numeric field (duration, fee, threshold) requires a non-empty source_url in the same record. This is the rule that stops an authoritative-sounding wrong number reaching a person planning a move.
quality_gates.provenance_representative: corridor packs must carry provenance='representative'. An agent-authored 'verified' is a fabricated SME sign-off.
quality_gates.no_marketing_copy: Rejects headline/tagline/meta-description shaped output and the banned marketing register (revolutionary, game-changing, seamless, powerful, supercharge, unlock, end-to-end, journey, adventure, exciting chapter, robust, best-in-class).
quality_gates.no_compliance_claim: Rejects any EU AI Act status claim — 'EU AI Act Ready', 'compliant', 'certified', 'conformant', 'high-risk AI system'. Hard gate in CLAUDE.md; a false or premature compliance claim is itself a legal liability. Mirrors scripts/check_compliance_claims.py.
quality_gates.thread_diff: Compares the synced file against the in-thread fallback block captured before the write task was authorised. Record counts must match and key fields must be identical. This exists because a measured 'convert-only' pass DRIFTED into fresh research: treat any second-pass output as new research, not a faithful copy.
quality_gates.url_resolves: Optional (--check-urls). HTTP HEAD/GET on every source_url and evidence_url; reports non-2xx. Off by default so the verifier stays offline-safe.
quality_gates.min_bytes: Prose deliverables (the gaps/notes files) are judged by substance, not record count. A gaps file is not optional: 'NONE' and 'this register is login-gated' are answers, an empty file is not.
